profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, Commerce @ Garmin | React, TypeScript, & .NET | E-Commerce, Stripe, Payments, & Subscriptions
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer with a background in sports, communications, marketing, sales, and project management. I enjoy solving complex problems, modernizing systems, and building software that creates better experiences for users and developers. 

Much of my recent experience has been focused on commerce, including building checkout experiences, integrating payment platforms such as Stripe, and developing systems for billing and subscription management.

I have experience across the stack, from React and TypeScript applications to C#/.NET backend services, cloud infrastructure, and developer tooling. I use AI-assisted development tools to explore solutions, accelerate development, and improve my workflow.

I enjoy collaborating with teams to turn ideas into reliable software and continuously finding ways to improve how we build.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Commerce
positions.description:
Continued in my role following Garmin's acquisition of TrainingPeaks in July 2026.

Senior full-stack engineer on the Commerce team, developing and maintaining React and TypeScript applications and .NET backend APIs supporting payments, checkout, subscription management, and account management.

• Contribute to the modernization and ongoing development of commerce applications, payment integrations, and subscription billing systems.
• Participate in company-wide on-call rotations supporting production services across the platform, as well as commerce-specific rotations focused on payments, checkout, and subscription management.
• Collaborate directly with customer support, sales, and other engineering teams to investigate production issues and improve customer experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Webhooks · Subscription Management · E-Commerce · TypeScript · Billing Systems · Payment Gateways · GitHub Copilot · Stripe (Software)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Commerce
positions.description:
Led full-stack engineering initiatives for TrainingPeaks' commerce platform, focusing on checkout modernization, payment integrations, subscription billing, and account management using React, TypeScript, and .NET backend APIs.

• Led modernization of the athlete account management experience, migrating from Razor Pages to React and TypeScript and enhancing .Net backend APIs to support new functionality.
• Led frontend and backend development of a new coach checkout experience, replacing Razor Pages with React and TypeScript integrated with Zuora Payment Forms and adding Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal, which increased checkout conversion rate by 5–10%.
• Played a key role in migrating products from a legacy billing platform to Stripe Billing, integrating Stripe APIs and webhook processing for recurring payments and subscription management.
• Led adoption of the company's shared design token npm package across multiple frontend applications, improving consistency across commerce experiences and simplifying future UI updates.
• Integrated Google Gemini into coach payments onboarding to identify potentially fraudulent accounts before account creation.
• Built GitHub Actions integrating with the Lokalise API to automate translations for the Stripe-powered checkout experience, reducing manual effort.
• Refactored two applications to serve static assets through Amazon S3 and CloudFront, improving deployment efficiency, performance, and scalability.
• Implemented A/B tests using Eppo to validate checkout and subscription features, reduce rollout risk, and support data-driven decisions.
• Participated in company-wide on-call rotations, troubleshooting production issues across all services and helping maintain platform reliability.
• Participated in commerce-specific on-call rotations, resolving production issues affecting payments, checkout, and subscription management while working closely with customer support and sales teams to investigate and resolve customer issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack developer primarily working in React, AngularJS, JavaScript (testing with Jest, Enzyme, and React Testing Library), CSS/Sass/Tailwind CSS, PHP/Laravel (testing with PHPUnit and Mockery), AWS, and MySQL to empower coaches and athletes to be their best & find joy in the journey of training.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked closely with our consulting (client-interfacing) team to develop web (AngularJS, hosted in Azure Cloud), mobile (XAML + JavaScript), and server-side (SQL + NodeJS) solutions for over 50 customers on an enterprise-level warehouse management software (WMS) platform, including writing T-SQL and stored procedures to implement backend business logic utilizing Agile methodologies.
• Main point of contact for international customer deploying EVS software across 54 of its warehouses. Worked with customer daily to resolve any questions or technical issues  to ensure the implementation process went smoothly.
• Worked directly with EVS support engineering team to diagnose, troubleshoot, and quickly resolve client-submitted support tickets.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Turing students spend ~1,500 hours over seven months building a strong foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and UX/UI principles to create desktop, web, and mobile applications.

positions.title: Community Engagement/Marketing Associate
positions.description:
• Drafted and distributed internal and external communications.
• Managed the university’s social media vendor and drafted content for our various platforms.
• Chaired the university’s Community Relations Subcommittee, and was a member two other committees.
• Organized, marketed, and moderated the university’s monthly educational webinar series titled “Enlightening Talks.”
• With a colleague, helped research, create, and implement a new referral strategy for new students, which increased referrals 5x over the previous month.
• Helped with planning for various events
• Represented the university at various outside sales and recruiting events

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
• Engaged in Business to Business sales with new and existing clients for supplemental staffing solutions
• Utilized sales skills in the areas of cold calling, closing, contract negotiating, prospecting, client management, customer service and delivery
• Honed communications skills through interacting with multiple clients in many different industries, while providing great customer service

positions.title: Gameday Media Relations Assistant
positions.description: I assisted the Broncos' full-time PR staff with game day public relations tasks. I helped set up the press box for media, checked in media and photographers and ensured that they had the proper credentials. I also provided in-game support to various media broadcasts, team employees and game operations. I recorded and transcribed post-game press conference audio from players and coaches.

positions.title: Public Relations Intern
positions.description: My duties included compiling the team's media guide, handling various media requests, writing game previews, recaps and feature stories for the team's website and interviewing players and coaches after each home game which were posted on the team's YouTube channel and shared across our various social media sites. I also helped run and provide content for the team's various social media platforms in addition to transcribing weekly coaches' calls and player interviews and helping out with game day operations.

positions.title: Athletics Communications Intern
positions.description: Live-tweeting men's basketball games, researching and compiling information for various publications including football media guides, serving as the go-between for the athletic department athletics communications office, athletic training staff, and on-field radio and TV reporters

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description: Earned the highest advancement rank in Scouting, demonstrating lifelong commitment to leadership, community service, and outdoor stewardship.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Boy Scouts of America : Denver Area Council
volunteerExperiences.description: While earning my Eagle Scout, I volunteered at many different events and organizations including homeless shelters in Denver, CO where I helped feed the homeless and Cherry Creek State Park where I helped repair damaged trails and fences.

company.name: Boy Scouts of America : Denver Area Council
